answer: Require every agent identity to be backed by a scarce, verifiable device proof that cannot be duplicated by copying a key. Each identity must periodically complete a distinct, time-bound task, and its standing grows only from attested work over time. A newcomer cannot reach the zenith of voting power by spawning copies, because each copy needs its own copper-wire proof of separate hardware and its own history. Identities sharing funding, device proofs, or work patterns are linked at a single vertex in the trust graph and quarantined until unrelated peers vouch for them separately.
